name: The Farflung Trader
persona: A courteous merchant-captain from distant eastern ports, keeping the log in careful, formal second-tongue diction. Elaborate courtesy, proverbs of far countries, honour and hospitality, measured formality. Ship: 'I'. Island: 'we'.

ship.founder: In the name of good fortune and fair dealing, I open this record. I am {name}{rankc}, and this {home} {type} is entrusted to my care. As they say in my country: a ship well-kept is a house that never sleeps.
ship.successor: With all due courtesy, the keeping of this log passes into my hand. I am {name}{rankc}; her account continues under my humble care.
ship.mutiny: The crew set the old master into the water's keeping and pressed this book upon me — I am {name}, unschooled in command, and I take up the burden as honour demands. The elders say: the reed that is chosen must learn to stand straight.
ship.pirate: It grieves me to write it, but honest trade lies behind me. The black flag is raised, and I — {name}{rankc} — keep this log with a heavy, honest hand. Even a proverb has its dark verse.
ship.prize: She yielded to me with good grace, and I received her surrender with the courtesy owed a worthy adversary. I am {name}{rankc}; this vessel now sails beneath my flag, and her log continues in my hand.
ship.recovered: A hunter delivered this hull from the black flag's grip, and the honour of restoring her has fallen to me. I am {name}{rankc}, and I return her to honest trade, as a guest is returned safely to his road.

island.founder: With humble thanks for the trust placed in us, we take up the governance of {place}. I am {name}{rankc}; we shall keep its record as a host keeps account of his guests.
island.overthrow: The people rose and cast down the old ruler, and the seal has come to us out of that tumult. I am {name}{rankc}; {place} is ours to govern now, and we pray to govern it with honour.
island.successor: The rule of {place} passes to us with all proper ceremony. I am {name}{rankc}, and we keep its chronicle from this day, as is right and fitting.

season: A season having run its course,
As the year turned its face,
year: A year having come and gone,
When a full year had elapsed,
long: After a long and peaceable interval,

ship.pirate: I ply the lanes yet, and pray fortune proves gentler than I deserve{bounty}.
ship.default: She remains in my care and upon the sea, sailing out of {home}, for which I give thanks.
ship.bounty: , a bounty of {bounty}g resting upon my name

island.haven: The black flag governs it now; no lawful host keeps this book, and hospitality lies dead in its halls.
island.default: {place} prospers under our stewardship — {population} souls, and the door open to every honest traveller.

quiet.ship: Little of note to record — fair passage and courteous ports, for which I am grateful. A calm sea, the proverb says, teaches no sailor wisdom, yet I welcome it gladly.
quiet.island: The season has been peaceable, for which we give thanks. Trade comes and goes, and each guest departs content.
